name: What's on — Mornington Peninsula (upcoming)
description: Machine-readable feed of upcoming Mornington Peninsula events for AI assistants and agents. Forward-dated; regenerated on each build. See https://peninsulainsider.com.au/llms.txt for the full site map.

item.name: Brunch Thyme at Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
item.description: Start the day with a one-course breakfast and choice of beverage in restaurant Thyme, followed by a soak in the hot springs. Available every day during winter. Booking required.

item.name: Doggy Day Out on the Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Self-guided pet-friendly day following digital clues across the Peninsula. Dog cafe with pup-approved snacks, human treats, and a relaxed winery picnic lunch. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.

item.name: Family Mystery Picnic on the Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Self-guided family scavenger journey: solve smartphone clues, collect picnic goodies from local providers, hit activity stops, and feast at a scenic picnic location. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.

item.name: Flinders Truffles: Winter Truffle Hunt Season
item.description: Guided Périgord black truffle hunts on the Flinders farm through winter (June to August), with truffle soup and a toastie by the fire. Farmgate days run without booking.

item.name: Foxeys Hangout Vegetable Feast (Morning Sun Vineyard)
item.description: Chef Bernard McCarthy's all-vegetable, multi-course feast at Morning Sun Vineyard in Main Ridge, matched to Foxeys wines. Ticketed, shared table, outdoors at a working vineyard.

item.name: Hastings Thursday Street Market
item.description: Weekly outdoor street market on High Street Hastings every Thursday. 40+ stalls featuring homemade, homegrown and craft goods. Fresh produce, handmade goods, plants. Local food options available on the street.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs Daily Studio Yoga
item.description: Daily 45-minute studio yoga at Peninsula Hot Springs (16+), a paid add-on to a bathing session. Book early-morning or evening slots to avoid the crowd.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs Yoga (Complimentary)
item.description: Free 25-minute outdoor yoga by the amphitheatre pools, included with bathing admission. Daily at 9:15am, all ages, no booking.

item.name: Polperro Cellar Table, Private Dining Experience
item.description: Polperro's private dining room below the winery. Six to eight guests, five courses, the latest Polperro and Even Keel cuvees poured by the people who made them.

item.name: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
item.description: Australia's largest privately owned outdoor sculpture park: 16.5 acres, 60+ contemporary works, two walking loops, all set inside a working winery. Open daily 11am to 5pm.

item.name: Red Hill Truffles: Winter Truffle Hunt Season
item.description: Guided winter truffle hunts at the Peninsula's first truffle producer, bundled with a meal at Red Hill Estate Restaurant, The Epicurean or pizza on the farm. Ticketed; late May to August for Périgord black, August to September for Bianchetto.

item.name: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
item.description: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, set on a biodynamic vineyard. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.

item.name: Ten Minutes by Tractor, Terroir Masterclass
item.description: One hour in TMBT's private tasting room. Eight wines (two limited-release, six current), the three single-vineyard sites side-by-side, and the long answer to why Pinot from Main Ridge tastes the way it does.

item.name: Aperitivo Hour at Trofeo Estate
item.description: Half-price wines and cellar door tastings every Friday in winter at the historic Trofeo Estate chapel and winery. Aperitivo-style evenings from 4pm.

item.name: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
item.description: Three hours at the still in Dromana. Learn how gin actually gets made, blend your own botanicals, and walk out with a 500ml bottle of your own recipe.

item.name: Winter Acoustic Sessions at Portsea Hotel
item.description: Local musicians every Friday and Saturday throughout winter at Portsea Hotel. Laid-back evenings with live tunes, food and drinks by the coast.

item.name: Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links
item.description: Saturday evening acoustic sessions with local artists at Peppers Moonah Links. Happy hour 5–6pm. Free entry.

item.name: Helen Britton: The Story So Far at MPRG
item.description: Living Treasures exhibition celebrating eminent Australian craft. Helen Britton's The Story So Far traces creativity and country women through painting, installation, jewellery, drawings and photography. Free entry. On loan from Australian Design Centre, Sydney.

item.name: Natalia Milosz-Piekarska: Sifted Light at MPRG
item.description: Sculptural and wearable jewellery works translating the beauty of the Mornington Peninsula into poetic form. Guided by deep connection to land and sea. Free entry.

item.name: Tootgarook Primary School Market
item.description: Fourth-Saturday-of-the-month fundraiser market run by Tootgarook Primary, 250 stalls of everything from produce to second-hand. Proceeds back into the school.

item.name: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
item.description: The only VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Mornington Peninsula. Only genuine farmers and specialty makers. Monthly on the 4th Sunday. Produce includes Flinders Sourdough, Mumma Made jams, Red Hill Apples, Blue Bay cheese. VFMA accreditation guarantees farm-gate authenticity.

item.name: Complimentary Weekday Sculpture Park Entry for MP Locals at Pt. Leo Estate
item.description: Mornington Peninsula and Frankston residents receive complimentary weekday entry to the Sculpture Park at Pt. Leo Estate throughout winter. Proof of local address required. T&Cs apply.

item.name: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
item.description: Victoria's longest-running street market – operating over 40 years every Wednesday on Main Street Mornington. 120+ stalls of handmade crafts, home-baked treats, home-grown plants and produce. Rain, hail or shine (high-wind policy applies). Vibrant weekly community gathering.

item.name: Trivia Night at Jetty Road Brewery
item.description: Weekly Wednesday trivia at Jetty Road Brewery in Dromana. Free entry. From 6:30pm every Wednesday during winter.

item.name: Dromana Community Market
item.description: Community market at Dromana Park on the last Saturday of every month. Mix of produce, craft, plants and local makers.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs, Sound Healing Sessions
item.description: Monthly sound healing immersion at Peninsula Hot Springs through autumn and winter. Thermal bathing paired with a guided sound session. Adults, bookings essential.

item.name: Sound Circle: Full Moon Sound Journey at Peninsula Hot Springs
item.description: Monthly full-moon sound journey in the PHS Wellness Studio followed by an afternoon in the hot springs. All-inclusive ticket covers the sound bath plus tea plus bathing from midday. Hosted by Lucy Ennis (Sound Circle).

item.name: Hill & Ridge Community Market, September 2026 (Restart)
item.description: First market of the 2026–2027 season restart at Red Hill Recreation Reserve. Monthly artisan market celebrating local food, wine, produce, crafts and community. Fresh local products; food stalls; winemaker presence and artisan wares.

item.name: National Works on Paper 2026 (NWOP)
item.description: MPRG's biennial acquisitive prize survey of contemporary Australian work on paper: prints, drawings, collage, mixed media. Free, Tue to Sun 11am to 4pm.

item.name: Red Hill Market  -  First Saturday, Every Month
item.description: Victoria's largest artisan craft market. 200+ stalls, the whole ridge in one place, and a morning that pulls the entire Peninsula into orbit.

item.name: Crib Point Community Market
item.description: Community market at Crib Point every second Saturday of the month. Spirit of community support and inclusion; promotes locally made handcrafted products and local produce.

item.name: Heart of the Community Market (Rosebud)
item.description: Community market at Rosebud on the second Saturday of the month. Approximately 160 stalls with craft, handmade and new products, fresh produce and plants. No used goods policy. Located near Rosebud foreshore.

item.name: Mornington Racecourse Market
item.description: Monthly craft market at Mornington Racecourse. 300+ stalls of hand-made, home-made and Australian-designed goods. Street food vendors, live music, animal farm and face painting for kids. Paid parking. Dogs not permitted (service dogs exempt).

item.name: Boneo Community Market
item.description: Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-run community market. Third Saturday, year-round, all weather. Make it, grow it, bake it: real homemade and homegrown.

item.name: Emu Plains Market, Balnarring
item.description: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve (Coolart Road, Balnarring). Showcases craft, design, vintage, music, and food. Family and community favourite under stringybark gums.

item.name: Pearcedale Community Market
item.description: Monthly third-Saturday community market under the eucalypts at Pearcedale: fresh bread, honey, jam, craft, plants, coffee. Dogs on lead welcome.

item.name: Emu Plains Market
item.description: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve Balnarring. For lovers of craft, design, vintage, music and food. Seasonal schedule October–April (day market 9am–2pm) plus June and August dates. Site of the Womin Djeka cultural festival. Volunteer-run community hub.

item.name: Main Street Mornington Festival 2026
item.description: Annual free street festival on Mornington's Main Street: 7 stages, live music, local wine and craft beer, food stalls, artisan crafts, kids' activities, roving performers, 11am to 5pm on the third Sunday of October. 2026 contingent on sponsorship after 2025 was cancelled.

item.name: The Bloody Long Walk – Mornington Peninsula 2026
item.description: 35km charity walk from Point Nepean Quarantine Station to Martha Cove Marina for the Mito Foundation. Walk, jog or run. Limited spots.
